summary: Evidence-backed clarifications for AI Evaluation Field Guide.

changes.text: Evaluate the full data mixture alongside its individual sources.
changes.rationale: An interaction can be absent from isolated source checks.

changes.text: Declare adaptive test limits and repeat policy before testing.
changes.rationale: Results depend on access, feedback and budget.

changes.text: Measure team results and individual actions under shared constraints.
changes.rationale: A group result can conceal unhealthy behavior by one participant.

changes.text: Revalidate detection when the model or reasoning settings change.
changes.rationale: Proxy scores and readable traces alone offer limited evidence about detection.
